result_text:
The Stop hook failed again on the same test, `src/social.test.ts > Social Providers > should refresh the access token`. Nothing has changed since I last looked at it.

It fails because the test calls `accounts.google.com`, which this environment can't reach (`getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN`). The log lines you pasted, "Missing or null Origin" and "Issuer URL", are ordinary test output, not the failure. The `last-login-method` change doesn't touch that code. All 26 tests for the plugin pass.

I haven't edited, skipped, or weakened that test, and I won't. To get the hook passing, either restore network access to that host or scope the hook's Vitest run so it excludes tests that need the network.
